title: NTT DATA Group cuts incident analysis to 30 minutes with Codex
summary: NTT DATA Group uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to help 9,000 employees automate work, cut incident analysis to 30 minutes, and scale secure AI adoption.
body: NTT DATA Group uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to help 9,000 employees automate work, cut incident analysis to 30 minutes, and scale secure AI adoption.
summaryZh: NTT DATA集团利用ChatGPT Enterprise和Codex帮助9000名员工自动化工作，将事件分析时间缩短至30分钟，并规模化推进安全可靠的AI应用。原始信息显示：NTT DATA Group uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to help 9,000 employees automate work, cut incident analysis to 30 minutes, and scale secure AI adoption.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“NTT DATA Group cuts incident analysis to 30 minutes with Codex”。其重要性主要体现在：NTT DATA集团通过部署ChatGPT Enterprise和Codex，成功将事件分析时间缩短至30分钟。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
